Learn moreSign in Comments 17 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description This is how our moon colonization phase begins | DW News 129Likes7,733ViewsApr 12026 Artemis II is more than a launch — it’s a test of humanity’s next chapter in space. Four astronauts will fly around the Moon, testing the Orion spacecraft and life‑support systems in deep space for the first time with a crew on board. This mission proves we can travel safely beyond Earth orbit again — and do it differently than before. The crew represents a new era of exploration, setting the stage for Artemis IV, where astronauts are planned to return to the lunar surface, establish long‑term presence, and prepare for journeys even farther out.
